notes: Reset checks have no disable iff (antecedent is reset asserted). The async part uses always @(negedge rst) with #1, which needs Verilator timing support (--timing). Both processes increment the same counters (the always_ff and the delayed block); with Verilator a variable driven from both always_ff and a plain always block may warn (MULTIDRIVEN), so if that comes up, split the async hits into separate counters.
